oracle: Real ML Kit Android SDK via android-oracle/run_oracle.sh on Pixel 45241FDAS000WM; all calls serial. Explicit per-trial output avoids modifying default host ink_output.json.
selection_policy: Retain only successful actual top candidate exactly equal to predeclared intended string. Null SDK scores are not numeric confidence. Rejected trials are excluded from entries.
path_base: Paths are relative to this manifest directory unless absolute command arguments.
